assertions.name: the complex Sabra q-ladder conserves energy inviscidly (per-triad coefficient sum is zero on any ladder; drift is RK2 only)
assertions.source: nu=0 short run per seed, relative energy drift < 1e-4

assertions.name: the modulus damped-forced form holds along actual trajectories: r_n = sup|u_n|*nu*k_n^2 / F_n(sup moduli) <= 1 on every excited empty-start rung, both seeds, every eps — the rung_equilibrium_forced instance for moduli is validated in the phase-dynamical model class
assertions.source: triangle-inequality forcing F_n = k_{n+1}|u_{n+1}||u_{n+2}| + delta*k_n|u_{n-1}||u_{n+1}| + (1-delta)*k_{n-1}|u_{n-1}||u_{n-2}| on sup moduli

assertions.name: PHASE VERDICT — phases WEAKEN the tail: the dissipation-scale crossing exists for moduli at every (seed, eps) AND the coherence ratio sup|u_n|(Sabra)/sup u_n(real DN) <= 1 on every tail rung excited in both models — phase decorrelation reduces tail excitation below the coherent (real-amplitude) level; the SF-arc real-model results are CONSERVATIVE with respect to phases in this model class
assertions.source: max coherence ratio per (seed, eps) over tail rungs excited in both models

description: SF10 (bean qou-wgyz): phase-decorrelation probe for the SF arc's irreducible caveat. Complex Sabra-type q-shell model (per-triad exact energy conservation on the [n]_q ladder, delta = 0.5, two deterministic phase windings), compared rung-by-rung against the real DN model at matched eps. Measures the modulus damped-forced ratio (the rung_equilibrium_forced instance — no new Lean needed, the invariant applies verbatim to moduli) and the coherence ratio sup|u_n|(Sabra)/sup u_n(DN). Scope (a); float64 complex RK2 exploratory tier; one phase-dynamical model class, not full NS sweeping.
